complements: inputs/FULLBODY-MESH-MANIFEST.json (bodyparts3d-fullbody-r1) and inputs/MESH-MANIFEST.json; no id here repeats one there (ids start with "zf-")

source.atlas: Z-Anatomy, the open source (libre) 3D atlas of anatomy, built on BodyParts3D

rights: Selected mesh derivatives: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0). Retain the supplied Z-Anatomy and BodyParts3D credits, source notices and change history. See ATTRIBUTION-AND-LICENCES.txt and LICENSES/. The project-owned game code has separate CC0 terms; Three.js has separate MIT terms. Those software licences do not change these mesh terms.
source_coordinate_rule: Recorded output coordinates are expressed in the BodyParts3D 4.0 frame in millimetres (+x subject LEFT, +y POSTERIOR, +z SUPERIOR) using one shared similarity transform. The fixed conversion reproduced the stored coordinate tokens and triangle sequence; registration accuracy and the physical/anatomical frame interpretation remain unvalidated. No per-mesh recentering, rigging or deformation is part of this conversion.

registration.method: point-to-plane similarity ICP, groups equally weighted, 10 % trimmed per group
pairs_used: bone-contact patches (|d| <= 3 mm) of Frontalis muscle (r, l)
bone-contact patches (|d| <= 3 mm) of Temporalis muscle (r, l)
bone-contact patches (|d| <= 3 mm) of Superficial part of masseter (r, l)
bone-contact patches (|d| <= 3 mm) of Deep part of masseter (r, l)
bone-contact patches (|d| <= 3 mm) of Nasalis muscle (r, l)
bone-contact patches (|d| <= 3 mm) of Zygomaticus minor muscle (r, l)
bone-contact patches (|d| <= 3 mm) of Levator nasolabialis (r, l)
bone-contact patches (|d| <= 3 mm) of Orbital part of orbicularis oculi (r, l)
bone-contact patches (|d| <= 3 mm) of Mentalis muscle (r, l)
bone-contact patches (|d| <= 3 mm) of Bucinator (r, l)
bone-contact patches (|d| <= 3 mm) of Medial pterygoid muscle (r, l)
bone-contact patches (|d| <= 3 mm) of Levator anguli oris (r, l)

selection: 54 OBJ asset records representing 27 paired named structures or parts, including facial-expression, scalp/platysma and chewing structures. Load the listed paths and hashes. This count is not 54 distinct biological muscles or complete facial coverage.
rig_hint_vocabulary: Recorded display-rig hints: a segment or [proximal, distal], using skull, mandible and thorax. attachment_bone records a geometric nearest-bone fallback. These hints and the action groups are not validated soft-tissue insertions, muscle mechanics or neural mappings.

missing.label: auricular muscles (anterior, superior, posterior auricular)
missing.reason: the source groups 'Extrinsic auricular muscles.g' and 'Intrinsic auricular muscles.g' exist but contain no mesh in MuscularSystem100.fbx

not_selected_in_source.reason: flat tendon sheet of the scalp, not a muscle

not_selected_in_source.source: Extra-ocular muscles.g (rectus, oblique, levator palpebrae superioris, tarsi, trochlea, common tendinous ring)
not_selected_in_source.reason: eye-moving and eyelid-lifting muscles: not facial-expression or chewing muscles
tongue muscles: not included in this packet
soft palate: not included in this packet

not_selected_in_source.source: Cervical part of muscular system.g (except platysma)
not_selected_in_source.reason: neck muscles: not included in this packet

cautions: Left and right records reuse source geometry through mirrored node instances. This is an atlas representation and does not measure an individual person’s facial asymmetry.

The source folder says: "These models may not be up to date. For the latest version of the Z-Anatomy models, please visit the official website" (Resources/Models/Readme.txt). The newer Blender file was not used.
One reference model for education; not a measured person, not a population average, not validated.

Registration: one similarity transform fitted jointly to the neck muscles found in both sources and to the places where face muscles lie on bone (their contact patches against the BodyParts3D skull and mandible). The skull itself is not in the downloaded file. Other reasonable fits move the face by a median 1.5 to 4.2 mm (at most 7.5 mm; two rejected fits that used a wrong trapezius pair: up to 11.3 mm): see registration.face_sensitivity_mm_vs_alternatives.
Embedded mesh comments retain the original producer wording. The fixed conversion reproduces its winding convention; anatomically outward normals and surface quality remain unvalidated.

bodymap_regions.note: Muscle ids of this packet per ns-bodymap face region. Each id also answers to the concept names in its manifest entry (concepts[].en), so the existing action lists (e.g. "left masseter", "orbicularis oris", "left orbicularis oculi") match every piece. Digastric and mylohyoid stay BodyParts3D (FJ ids).

eyelid.note: Levator palpebrae superioris is present in the source but is not included in this packet.

jaw.note: the superior head of lateral pterygoid mainly steadies the jaw joint; listing it with opening is a simplification (both heads answer to "<side> lateral pterygoid")

tongue.note: No tongue muscle is included. Genioglossus and hyoglossus are present in the source but were not extracted into this packet.
